detail.historicBody: This relationship is historic. It is listed for context.
detail.noContact: No public contact route; use the organisation's own channels.
detail.sourcesFoot: Each source opens in a new tab. The date is when Kafa'a last checked it.
detail.agreementsDesc: Each publicly reported agreement with its type, date, binding flag and source.
detail.futureBody: See the ADVANCE programme and the skills these technologies may need.

sup.intro: How to supply Barakah: localisation opportunities, quality expectations, In-Country Value, then the readiness path and registration with ENEC.
sup.prepBody: Kafa'a helps suppliers get ready. ENEC's procurement and quality functions qualify suppliers through ENEC's own supplier registration. Nothing here is a registration, a qualification or an award.

f.mailboxHint: A role mailbox such as procurement@yourcompany.ae. Please do not use a personal address.

f.consent: I agree that Kafa'a passes this message to ENEC's supplier development team.
f.consentHint: Kept only for routing. No marketing.

sup.sentTitle: Thank you. Your message was routed to supplier development.
sup.sentBody: Expect a reply to your company mailbox. Kafa'a does not register suppliers.

onb.intro: Your organisation's readiness file for ENEC's supplier registration.
onb.prepBody: Kafa'a prepares your file. ENEC's procurement and quality functions decide on registration and qualification.
onb.noCase: No onboarding case for your organisation
onb.noCaseBody: ENEC's supplier development team opens a case when it invites a supplier. Contact the partner desk if you expected one.
onb.returnedBody: Read the note, fix what is asked and submit again.
onb.submittedBody: Documents are locked while ENEC reviews them. Withdraw the submission if you need to change something.
onb.approvedBody: ENEC will hand your summary to supplier registration.
onb.readOnlyBody: Your partner admin manages this file. You can follow its status here.
onb.progressLine: {steps} of {stepsTotal} steps done · {docs} of {docsTotal} required documents in
onb.startBody: This opens your readiness file for editing. The action is recorded in the audit log.
onb.submitBody: Your file goes to ENEC for review and the readiness summary is generated. Documents lock until ENEC decides or you withdraw. Evidence will be recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.
onb.submitNotReady: Some conditions are not met yet. Submission will be refused until they are.
onb.withdrawBody: The file returns to you for changes. ENEC's review stops.
onb.nonSupplier: The readiness path is for suppliers. Your case status and history are below.

stepBody.orientation: Read how Barakah procurement works and where localisation opportunities are. Upload your trade licence and company profile.
stepBody.quality: Show how you meet ASME and NQA-1 expectations, commercial-grade dedication and CFSI prevention. Supplier academy courses SA 101-103 help.
stepBody.safety_culture: Apply the safety culture traits to your work and set up defect reporting. Courses SA 104 and SA 107 help.
stepBody.icv: Keep your ICV certificate current and submit an improvement plan.
stepBody.self_assessment: Score your organisation from 1 to 4 in six areas. ENEC reads it as your view, not as an assessment.
stepBody.handoff: After ENEC approves your file, it hands your readiness summary to ENEC's supplier registration. ENEC completes this step.

link.academySafety: Safety culture courses in the academy

onb.selfBody: Score each area from 1 (not in place) to 4 (in place and audited). Be candid: ENEC uses it to plan support, not to qualify you.
onb.lockedHint: Editing is closed while the case is with ENEC or after a decision.
onb.docsBody: Choose a file to record it. Kafa'a computes a SHA-256 fingerprint in your browser and records the name, size and fingerprint; in this concept the file itself stays with you.
onb.docsLocked: Documents can be changed only while your case is open (invited, in progress or returned).

sum.intro: Take this summary to ENEC's supplier registration. It shows exactly what you submitted.
sum.noneBody: The summary is generated when you submit your readiness file for ENEC review.
sum.disclaimerAr: Prepared by Kafa'a for ENEC supplier registration. Kafa'a prepares suppliers; ENEC's procurement and quality functions qualify them. This summary is not a registration, a qualification or an award.
sum.next: Next: ENEC's supplier registration (in this concept, the NEXUS partner lens at /partner/readiness).

academy.intro: Short courses for supplier and contractor staff, each with a knowledge check and an internal course certificate.
academy.conceptBody: Course titles come from the ENEC NEXUS concept (SA 101-108). They are concept content until ENEC confirms a supplier curriculum. Certificates are internal Kafa'a course certificates, never licences.
academy.checkLocked: Complete all modules to unlock the knowledge check.
academy.noCheck: This course has no knowledge check yet.
academy.failBody: The pass mark is {n}%. Review the modules and try again.
academy.certNote: Answers are scored on the server. Certificates can be checked by anyone on the verification page; they show initials only.
academy.noCertsBody: Pass a course's knowledge check to receive one.
academy.noTeam: No people in your organisation yet.
academy.assignBody: The person is enrolled and sees the course in their academy. The action is recorded in the audit log.

wf.intro: Evidence and equivalency requests for your contractor staff. You see only your own organisation.
wf.ruleBody: Contractor staff must meet the same qualifications as ENEC staff, through ENEC training or an equivalency process. You submit evidence per person; an ENEC evaluator maps it to the qualification standard and records the decision. Security qualifications are not handled here.
wf.staffDesc: Supplier academy progress and equivalency status per person.
wf.noStaff: No contractor staff linked to your organisation.
wf.notFoundBody: This record does not exist or belongs to another organisation. The attempt was recorded in the audit log.
wf.notMapped: Not yet mapped by an ENEC evaluator.

f.label: Person reference
f.labelHint: An internal reference, not a full name (for example: Technician G-03).
f.standardHint: Security qualifications are not available for equivalency.
f.attachHint: Optional: a fingerprint is recorded, the file stays with you.

wf.privacyBody: Send only what shows the person can do the tasks. No medical details, no clearance details, no ID documents.
wf.submitBody: The request goes to ENEC's evaluators. You can follow its status here. The action is recorded in the audit log.

icv.intro: Your ICV certificate and improvement plan. ENEC reviews submitted plans.
icv.explain2: Your plan states your current score, the target and year, and the levers that close the gap. Submitted plans are reviewed by ENEC; a returned plan comes back with a note.
icv.lockedBody: The plan is locked while ENEC reviews it.
icv.readOnly: Your partner admin edits the ICV plan.
icv.scoreSim: SIMULATED score for a synthetic supplier
icv.short: Does not cover the gap yet
icv.saveBody: The draft is saved for your organisation. The action is recorded in the audit log.
icv.submitBody: ENEC reviews the plan. It locks until ENEC reviews or returns it. Evidence will be recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.

problem.lever_invalid: Each lever needs a name and positive points

icv.chartNote: The marker shows the gap between baseline and target.
icv.simNote: Scores for synthetic demo suppliers are simulated.

adm.intro: Review supplier readiness files: check each document, review the ICV plan, then approve, return with a note, or hand off to ENEC's supplier registration.
adm.prepBody: Kafa'a prepares suppliers. Approval here means the readiness file is complete and checked; registration and qualification happen in ENEC's procurement system.
adm.readOnlyBody: Auditors can read every file and its history but cannot take decisions.

decide.approvedBody: The readiness file is complete and every required document has been accepted. The decision is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.
decide.returnedBody: The file goes back to the supplier with your note. Write what they must fix.
decide.handed_offBody: The readiness summary is handed to ENEC's supplier registration (the NEXUS partner lens). The hand-off step completes for the supplier.

adm.approveBlocked: Approval needs every required document accepted and a complete readiness path ({n} documents open).
adm.acceptDocBody: Marks the document as checked against the checklist. Recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.
adm.rejectDocBody: The supplier sees your note and must upload a new version.
adm.icvReviewedBody: The plan is marked reviewed. Recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.
adm.icvReturnBody: The plan goes back to draft with your note.
adm.auditNote: Every review and decision writes an audit event.

interest.title: Register-interest requests and invitations
interest.intro: Requests sent from the suppliers and universities pages. Open an onboarding case from a request, or invite an organisation directly. Kafa'a prepares a file; registration stays with ENEC procurement.

f.name: Organisation name (English)
f.nameHint: 2 to 120 characters; must not match an existing organisation.
f.scopeHint: Shown to the reviewers only; the organisation is not listed publicly.

interest.supplierNote: A supplier case starts with the six readiness steps and the twelve-document checklist, all open. The organisation's partner admin completes them.
interest.otherNote: University and international cases have no supplier checklist; ENEC records the decision and history.
interest.confirmBody: Creates the organisation "{name}" (not public) and an invited onboarding case. The action is audited.

eqr.intro: Map contractor evidence to the task items of the qualification standard, then record the decision.
eqr.ruleBody: Only an evaluator qualified for the standard (or the training manager) decides. "Equivalent" needs every task item covered by cited evidence. Decisions are final and need a note; the contractor's organisation sees the status and your note.
eqr.qualified: You hold the evaluator qualification for this standard.
eqr.notQualifiedBody: You can read the request, but only a qualified evaluator or the training manager can map evidence and decide.
eqr.mapBody: Saves the mapping ({n} of {total} tasks covered) and moves the request to under review. Recorded in the audit log.
eqr.equivalentBlocked: Equivalent is available when every task is covered ({n} not yet).
eqr.decideBody: The decision is final. It is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger, and the contractor's organisation sees it with your note.

reasons.link_strong: Holds {skill} at level {have} backed by records (the task needs {need}).
reasons.link_claimed: {skill} at level {have} is self-claimed only (the task needs {need} on record).
reasons.link_near: {skill} is at level {have}, one below the {need} the task needs.
reasons.link_none: No evidence of {skill} at the level the task needs ({need}).
reasons.prior_mapping: An ENEC evaluator already mapped this task as covered on {date}.
reasons.no_link: No skill map for this task yet: the evaluator reviews it.
reasons.academy_course: Supplier academy course {code}: you can enrol from the academy.
reasons.enec_course: ENEC course {code}: ask your ENEC sponsor about a place.
reasons.matrix_readiness: Readiness for this role profile: {pct}% (F02 readiness over the passport).
reasons.fr_req_met: Every one of the {n} contractors holds {skill} at level {need} or above, backed by records.
reasons.fr_req_bridge: {met} of {n} contractors hold {skill} at level {need}; {bridge} more have a foundation (one level short, or a recorded level 2+ in a related skill).
reasons.fr_req_new: {met} of {n} contractors hold {skill} at level {need}; for the rest it is new.
reasons.fr_req_suppressed: {skill} at level {need} is a 2030 need of this role. Counts are suppressed: fewer than 10 contractors.
reasons.fr_no_future: The 2030 profile of {role} adds no future-skill need beyond today's profile.
reasons.fr_no_profile: {role} has no published 2030 profile yet: only today’s profile can be compared.

cp.introAdmin: Your contractors' skills passports, built from supplier academy certificates, ENEC equivalency decisions and ENEC engagement sign-offs, set against the ENEC role profiles your organisation is contracted for. Only your organisation's people are shown.
cp.introSelf: Your portable skills passport: academy certificates, ENEC equivalency decisions and engagement sign-offs travel with you from one ENEC engagement to the next.
cp.mirrorBody: The passport and the pre-check are guidance. Equivalency is decided only by an ENEC evaluator, and nothing here is a FANR certification or an ENEC qualification. Security qualifications are handled outside Kafa'a.
cp.noPassportBody: Complete supplier academy courses or ask your partner admin to submit an equivalency request: your passport fills in from there.
cp.notFoundBody: This passport does not exist or is not shared with you. Passports are visible only to the person, their own organisation and ENEC evaluators.

stat.readySub: every required competency met; contracted band {band}

cp.radarNote: Levels come from the evidence on the passport (F01 rules). The outline shows what the ENEC role profile requires.
cp.noProfile: No ENEC role profile to compare with yet.
cp.evidenceIntro: Where this skill level comes from. Each line is a record Kafa'a mirrors; nothing here is a qualification decision.
cp.credNote: Wrap a valid academy certificate as a signed Open Badges 3.0 credential (F04) to share it outside Kafa'a. Internal Kafa'a credential; not a FANR certificate or licence.
cp.wrapTitle: Wrap this certificate as a badge?
cp.wrapConsequence: Kafa'a signs an Open Badges 3.0 credential for {course}. Anyone with the link can verify it; it shows your initials only.
cp.engOpen: In progress: sign-off at the end of the engagement.
cp.exportNote: A verifiable presentation with your signed badges; no email, photo or task detail.
cp.noTargetsBody: ENEC records which role profiles your organisation is contracted to staff. Ask your ENEC contract owner.
cp.noContractors: No contractor staff in your organisation yet.
cp.matrixCaption: Contractor team matrix: level per required competency, readiness and equivalency status
cp.pcDesc: Compares the passport with each task of the standard and shows the likely coverage. It reads only: the equivalency record never changes.
cp.pcIntro: Check how a contractor's passport covers a standard's tasks before you submit an equivalency request.
cp.pcChoose: Choose a contractor of your organisation.
cp.pcSecurity: Security qualifications are not handled through equivalency in Kafa'a and are not listed.
cp.pcCounts: {likely} likely, {partial} partial and {gaps} gaps out of {total} tasks; {critical} critical gaps.
cp.pcOpen: An equivalency request is already open ({id}): the evaluator is reviewing it.
cp.pcPrior: Tasks an evaluator already mapped as covered ({id}) count as likely.
cp.pcSuggestNote: Courses whose content evidences the skills behind the tasks not yet likely. Supplier academy courses first.
cp.pcSubmitConsequence: The request for {code} goes to an ENEC evaluator with {n} evidence items from the passport. Only the names are sent; files stay with you.

outlookText.already_equivalent: An ENEC evaluator has already found this passport equivalent for {code}.
outlookText.likely_equivalent: Every task of {code} looks covered by the passport. The evaluator still maps the evidence and decides.
outlookText.review: Part of {code} is covered; the evaluator will need to look at the partial tasks.
outlookText.training_likely: At least one critical task of {code} has no evidence: training is likely before equivalency.

cp.evalBody: You see this contractor's passport because you hold the equivalency evaluator role. Use the pre-check to prepare, then map the evidence and decide on the equivalency queue.

adm.intro: Record the ENEC role profiles each supplier is contracted to staff. Partner admins then see their contractors against these profiles. Security, cyber and safeguards roles are never contracted through the passport.
adm.roleHint: Security, cyber and safeguards roles are not listed.
adm.confirmBody: {org} is contracted for {role} with a headcount band of {band}. The supplier's partner admin sees it at once. Recorded in the evidence ledger.
adm.readOnly: Read-only: only an ENEC partner administrator can change contracted role profiles.

fr.intro: How ready are contractors for the skills the 2030 versions of ENEC role profiles add? Computed from the contractor passport (records only, never self-ratings) against each contracted role. Kafa'a prepares; ENEC decides.
fr.emptyBody: Your organisation is not a supplier with contractors or contracted ENEC role profiles yet.
fr.tContractorsSub: People of kind contractor on the passport
fr.suppressedBody: Fewer than 10 contractors: counts are suppressed. The 2030 needs and course suggestions are still shown.
fr.orgLine: {n} contractors · {pct} of future-skill needs met · {roles} contracted role profiles
fr.futureVal: {pct} met, {bridge} with a foundation, across {n} future needs
fr.groupNone: Not asked by the 2030 profiles of the contracted roles
fr.suggestDesc: Ranked by the contractor passport engine (F33): supplier academy first, then ENEC courses, each with the gaps it closes.
fr.noSuggest: No course in the catalogue evidences these needs yet.
fr.gapsBody: No supplier academy course evidences these 2030 needs yet: {skills}. ENEC courses above are the nearest options.
fr.m1: Population: people of kind contractor on the organisation's passport. Company representatives are not counted.
fr.m2: A future need is a 2030 profile requirement that today's profile does not ask for, or asks at a lower level (FS05 role profiles).
fr.m3: Met: held at the 2030 level, backed by records (self-claimed levels never count). Foundation: one level short, or a recorded level 2+ in the same competency or an adjacent skill. New: neither.
fr.m4: Organisations with fewer than 10 contractors show no counts at all. Security, cyber and safeguards content stays out.
fr.m5: Guidance for supplier development only: it is not an equivalency decision, a qualification or a FANR status.

pa.introSelf: Choose which parts of your passport an ENEC evaluator may see before you mobilise. The link expires on the day you set and you can revoke it at any time.
pa.introAdmin: Pre-arrival shares of your organisation's contractors. Only the contractor and ENEC evaluators see the shared items.
pa.introEval: Contractors share a chosen part of their passport before mobilisation. Open a share to run the pre-check from the shared items only.
pa.guidanceBody: The pre-arrival check uses only the items the contractor shared. It writes no skill evidence and no qualification or equivalency status: an ENEC evaluator decides on arrival.
pa.behalfNote: Contractors cannot sign in to Kafa'a on the live platform. Record exactly the items the contractor chose on their signed consent form, with its reference. The contractor is notified and can ask to revoke at any time.
pa.fStandard: Qualification standard to check before arrival
pa.fItemsHint: Only what you tick is shared. Security and medical details are never shareable.
pa.noItems: No shareable items on this passport yet.
pa.fLabelHint: 3 to 80 characters, for example the outage or work package
pa.fExpiresHint: 1 to 90 days from today, and not before mobilisation
pa.fConsentRefHint: Reference of the contractor's signed consent (3 to 80 characters)
pa.previewNote: The evaluator sees these items with the holder initials only, until the link expires or is revoked.
pa.cPreview: I reviewed what the evaluator will see.
pa.cShare: I agree to share them until {date}.
pa.cItemsBehalf: The contractor chose exactly these items on the form.
pa.cPreviewBehalf: The contractor reviewed what the evaluator will see.
pa.cShareBehalf: The contractor agreed to share them until {date}.
pa.confirmBody: {n} items become visible to ENEC evaluators until {date}. You can revoke the link at any time.
pa.behalfConfirmTitle: Record this share on the contractor's behalf?
pa.behalfConfirmBody: {n} items, consent form {ref}, visible to ENEC evaluators until {date}. This is recorded in the audit trail and the ledger.
pa.createdBody: Your pre-arrival share is ready for ENEC evaluators.
pa.emptySelf: Create one before your next mobilisation.
pa.emptyAdmin: None of your contractors has shared a pre-arrival record yet.
pa.emptyEval: No contractor has shared a pre-arrival record yet.
pa.summary: {likely} of {total} tasks likely from {skills} shared skills ({pct})
pa.revokeBody: The evaluator will no longer see the shared items and the pre-check cannot run.
pa.revokeEvalBody: Record the contractor's reason. The evaluator view and the public check stop showing the items at once.
pa.notFoundBody: It does not exist or you cannot open it.
pa.consentBehalfVal: Recorded on behalf by an ENEC evaluator, consent form {ref}
